review_checks.finding: Registration executes git show and git rev-parse on the exact predeclared 40-hex commit and repository-relative TRANSPORT.json path, recomputes the Git blob SHA-1, verifies its declared blob, acquisition execution seal, and DATASET SHA-256. Every restored regular file must match the committed inventory, bytes and SHA-256; symlink files are rejected.

Analysis reconstructs each development/fixed/equal-CPU job from the sealed design and learning-rate choices, requires exact unique job identifiers and complete wait4 attempts, and separately requires the exact eight formal seed identities.

Analysis reads all updates 1..N, validates increasing finite CPU clocks, finite losses and gradients, loss-component sums, state probability checks, exact midpoint/final validation clocks, and the first full-update crossing of the registered 60-second CPU budget.

Analysis binds the learning-rate lock to this protocol and exact model set, recomputes each model development CE/step/LR argmin, verifies its exact result path/hash/score, and requires development completion before global lock and all formal training/test access after that lock.

Selected checkpoint and selection receipt are fsynced before any worker test-array loading. Analysis verifies selection and final tensor hashes, exact train/validation/test access order, and selected validation argmin.

Separate audio/video encoders receive the same 32-step 128-dimensional modality inputs and positive observed elapsed dt. Common frontend/readout/head initialization is paired. Active backbone parameters remain within 3%; no padding parameters are introduced.

Shared linear mean fusion and symmetric InfoNCE are implemented as declared. Exact whole-pool and within-actor ranks, derangements and classification metrics passed independent synthetic checks. Duplicate in-batch clips can be false negatives for every arm. Shuffled-pair degradation is explicitly not proof of cross-modal synergy.

Intervals resample paired initialization seeds and actor identities independently on the 8-by-8 effect matrix while retaining each actor clip cluster. Exact discrete-convolution synthetic checks agree within declared Monte Carlo tolerance. Eight-actor population coverage remains approximate; retrieval is secondary and conditioned on its fixed candidate pool.

Wait4 covers each exact worker child through exit. Training and inference clocks are contained measures and cannot be added again; acquisition/decoding/registration are separate receipts. Negative scientific results remain successful execution; incomplete analysis or failed workers exit nonzero.

scope: Independent read-only source review plus synthetic metric/bootstrap checks. No real cohort arrays, validation predictions, test predictions, checkpoints, or experimental outcomes were loaded. Owner preflight002 and hosted immutable-data registration remain separate required execution receipts. Review binds only the listed current source hashes and is not a claim of HCSN superiority.
